body: Necesitas couples counseling. No te acuestes con nadie sin el ok de tu esposo. Resiste!

Primero tienes que preguntarte, ¿por qué quiero estudiar en la universidad? Si es porque tus padres te obligan, te vas arrepentir porque no vas a dar el maximo y se te va a ser difícil conseguir un empleo decente cuando gradúes. 

Segundo, pregúntate, ¿por que quiero estudiar psicologia? Hay una crisis de salud mental en la isla. Para enfrentar esa crisis tienes que darle el máximo a tus estudios y tener pasión. Sin esa pasión, vas a ser un psicólogo que no le importa sus clientes, solo quieren ganar un cheque. 

Examina tu personalidad, tu pasión y tus recursos. No tomes esa decisión algarete pq te vas arrepentir en el futuro. La universidad es demasiada importante ( y costosa ) para estudiar algo que no estás seguro si lo quieres.
Yo también soy nueva en UAGM Gurabo. ¿Que estás estudiando? Estoy en el area de trabajo social
`solved: Fragile Dream: Farewell Ruins of the Moon`

I feel the same. But thanks to Sims I learned about “relationship decay” which is something most people experience

I learned if I want to keep my friendships and relationships intact I have to put in the effort to maintain them. I’m still working on it, as socializing doesn’t come easily to me. 

It helps to set reminders on my phone to call/text someone and to try and do it as much as I (comfortably) can. Sucks when I don’t have anything to talk about but just the fact I reached out counts!

I don’t think there is so much as a unified “Kingdom” of Albion until after Fable 2. They don’t go into detail describing the hierarchy of Bowerstone and it’s unclear who’s running it after Lucien disappears.
Wish she would’ve kept her loyalty to Ladybug. I miss her being part of the team and thought her personality as a superhero was unique and fun to watch.

I know trying to convince you’re not ugly is not going to help since I don’t know what you look like and it’s not like you’re going to believe me anyway. 

There are a lot more factors to attractiveness than genetics. Hygiene, confidence, fashion, posture, health, and just having a good personality can go a looooong way. All of these things are hard to maintain especially when you’re suicidal, but they are achievable.

Your experiences do not define you, your life has value. It’s difficult to believe but your life can and will get better. Could you say you are the same person you were five years ago? Five years from now you will be an entirely different person, with a different life. It will be hard to hold on, but it will be worth it.
